item.title: Texas Judge Orders Camp Mystic To Preserve Damaged Grounds Hit By Last Year’s Deadly Flood

item.title: School Choice Suit
item.description: A Muslim parent is suing Texas for excluding Islamic schools from the state’s new school choice program. The lawsuit names Comptroller Kelly Hancock, who says the decision is backed by the state Attorney General. He pointed to a recent designation of both CAIR and the Muslim Brotherhood as Foreign Terrorist Organizations. The man who is suing is a recent immigrant from Morocco and his two kids now attend an Islamic school in Houston.

item.title: Fired Chaplin Settles
item.description: The former chaplain for the Austin Fire Department, who was fired for his opposition to transgender sports participation, has settled his lawsuit against the city. Andrew Fox wrote on his personal blog that he believes allowing biological men to compete in women’s sports contradicts what’s in the Bible. The Fire Department demanded an official apology, which he refused. That’s when he was fired. Fox sued, citing his free speech rights. The city settled out of court and has since apologized.
